messages:
Alex B.: Quick sync — final handover timeline for Console Observability cutover. We want to move trace & error-analysis retention from 90d -> 30d this sprint. Any blockers?
Priya S.: Tracing hooks are landed in staging, but one schema tweak for trace.headers was added in PR #542. Needs review + a migration run on staging before prod.
Chen L.: From SRE side: retention change will trigger index compaction. Need a maintenance window for the compact job (30–60m) and a rollback plan if query latency spikes.
Marta P.: Product ask: we need wording for customers (inc. impact on historical search) and a note for the changelog. Who owns that copy?
Alex B.: Owners + high-level dates please. Can we canary next Wed and full cutover Fri?
Priya S.: Owners: tracing hooks -> Priya (eng-runtime), error-analysis views -> Marta/product + Priya for infra. Migration step owner -> Chen. Timeline: canary Wed 09:00 UTC (10% traffic/compute), monitor 24h, full Fri 02:00 UTC.
Chen L.: OK on timing but request: shift canary to Thu morning for quieter infra ops window. Also need a feature flag to toggle retention per-route.
Alex B.: Good call. Move canary to Thu 08:00 UTC. Chen, can you own the canary playbook?
Chen L.: Yep. I'll draft the playbook and runbook. Plan includes health checks and a quick rollback command.
Priya S.: PR #542 -> @alex @chen can you review today? small change, will add a short migration script.
Alex B.: On it, will review by EOD.
Marta P.: I'll draft customer-facing notes and attach to the release ticket. ETA tomorrow noon.
Priya S.: Retention config snippet we'll deploy as part of infra config:```yaml
observability:
  traces:
    default_retention: 30d
    per_route_overrides: {}
  error_views:
    retention: 30d
```
Chen L.: Canary run command (ops):```bash
# enable canary retention policy
opsctl feature-flag set console.retention_canary=true --env=prod --percent=10
# apply config
opsctl config apply observability/retention-v2.yaml --env=prod
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: observability/retention-v2 (build 2026.03.11) — awaiting approvals
Alex B.: Approvals: @priya please merge once reviewed. @chen will you trigger canary Thu?
Priya S.: Will merge after alex review.
Chen L.: Will trigger and monitor; attaching brief canary checklist in the ticket.
Marta P.: Added changelog blurb and customer note draft to the release ticket — feedback welcome.
Alex B.: Great. Action items: Priya review PR + merge; Chen draft/run canary playbook + trigger Thu; Marta customer notes + changelog. Ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
